description: Control static wallpapers from Wallhaven and live video wallpapers from Pixabay from the topbar tray. Includes Start/Stop rotation, next/previous/shuffle actions, time-of-day tags & Wallhaven color palettes, schedule, and recent 10 wallpapers.
